title: Academic services
description: Academic services of the Office of the Royal Society: online requests, academic enquiries, dictionary and coined-term search systems, forms and complaint channels.

blocks.heading: Language and Academic Services
blocks.lead: Submit requests, make academic enquiries and search Thai-language databases, all in one place.

blocks.heading: Online services
blocks.lead: Choose a service and fill in the online form. Staff will contact you through the channel you specify.

items.title: Academic information inquiry
items.body: Send questions about the Thai language, vocabulary, language standards and the knowledge of the Royal Society of Thailand.

items.title: Request permission to publish
items.body: Request permission to use the Office's content, books or publications, with supporting documents.

items.title: Request a visit/study tour
items.body: For educational institutions and organizations wishing to make a study visit to the Office of the Royal Society.

items.title: Choose the service you need
items.body: Check the conditions and required documents for each service

items.title: Fill in the online form
items.body: Complete all information and attach supporting documents

items.title: Await review
items.body: Staff will contact you through the channel you specify

items.title: Receive the decision
items.body: Track the status with the request number you receive
